original_physical_plan.initialization: PHI=-1 inside reconstructed initial cumulative perimeter, +1 elsewhere; no point ignitions
source_terrain_limitations: GOFER is hourly retrospective cumulative satellite reconstruction, not ground arrival
GOES native resolution is about 2km at equator; 100m rasterization adds no observed detail
GOFER final FRAP references and other hindsight preprocessing prevent as-of validation
Initial cumulative perimeter is not an observed active fire front everywhere
Copernicus GLO90 is surface DSM, not bare-earth DTM; later release does not prove 2019 availability
LF2016 depicts 2016 ground conditions but capable fuels may refer to 2019/2020; 2019 as-of unverified
Nearest 30m-to-100m fuel resampling loses subcell fuel mixtures and does not estimate moisture
Canopy structure is absent; canopy zeros in a surface-fire scenario are explicit assumptions
Nonburnable model categories or outside-domain cells do not imply personal safety
Future geometries are stored separately and excluded from input-domain construction
source_weather_limitations: Two-hour model-cycle lag is a fixed assumption, not historical release proof
3km wind resampled to100m does not resolve100m atmospheric processes
Archived operational forecast, not observed future weather
This US development case does not validate Korean personal risk
original_physical_plan.label_boundary: Freeze three cases and write fit receipt before opening future reconstructed labels
limitations: GOFER source uses retrospective final-perimeter filtering; not operational as-of input
100m regridding does not create100m observation truth
One train event, no held-out model selection or Korean transfer validation
Fuel model, zero canopy and moisture assumptions cannot establish actual fire behavior
Negative/zero-union metrics stay undefined; no calibrated probability is computed

changes_from_original: Actual LF2016 CC/CH/CBH/CBD in landscape bands5..8
unchanged: Seven HRRR wind fields and true-to-grid rotation
limitations: LF2016 circa2016 canopy models are not measured September2019 canopy conditions
LF2016 capable fuels can represent expected2019/2020 regrowth in disturbed areas
Historical source availability and fire-day canopy accuracy are unverified
30m source sampled to100m loses subcell canopy structure; no new spatial detail
Canopy wind shielding means adding canopy need not increase surface spread
Crown-fire activation depends on moisture, intensity and model assumptions
No inference about Korean fire behavior or individual risk probability
Walker labels were exposed during development; this is not held-out evaluation
Density-only source cells retained including1initialcell; no invented canopy
Crown model cannot create validated personal or Korean risk probabilities
All six cases are reported; improved train-event score is not transfer evidence
